urdu transliteration:
Zahoor-e Imam-e Zamanah (aj)
Khuda kaash mujh ko dikhaaye
72 shaheedon ki soorat
Mujhe Karbala aazmaaye
english translation text:
May God grant me the sight
of the Advent of the Imam of the Age (عج)
May God show me,
And in the likeness of the seventy-two martyrs, may Karbala test me

urdu transliteration:
Ho awaaz Umm-e Wahab (a) ki
Uthe meri maan ki sada mein
Liya karte wapas nahin hum
Jo dein cheez raah-e Khuda mein
Kata sar utha kar woh dushman
Ki jaanib mera phenk aaye
english translation text:
May the voice of Umm e Wahab (a)
echo in the words of my mother;
What we offer in the path of God,
we do not take back.
And may she hurl my severed head
towards the ranks of the enemy.

urdu transliteration:
Dhule noor ki chaandni se
Mere dil ki saari siyaahi
Imam-e Zamanah (aj) ki aaghosh
Mein jaan de yeh sipahi
Badan ki mehak se yeh duniya
Mujhe Joan (a) keh kar bulaaye
english translation text:
May every darkness within my heart
be washed in the moonlight of Divine radiance;
May this soldier breathe his last
within the embrace of Imam of the Age (عج)
And through the fragrance of this body,
may the world call me John

urdu transliteration:
Haram ki hifazat mein aaye
Mayssar kabhi Shaam jaana
Za'eefi mein misl-e jawaan ho
Meri jang dekhe zamana
Main Ibn-e Mazahir (a) ke peeche
Sinaa par chalun sar uthaaye
english translation text:
To guard the Sanctuary,
should the chance arise to journey unto Shaam;
Despite frailty, like the young,
may I fight such that the world witness my resolve.
Behind Ibn e Muzahir (ع),
may I walk upon the spearheads with head held high.

urdu transliteration:
Banoon Hur (a), meri zindagi mein
Utar aaye aisa sawera
Ho qurbaan Mehdi (aj) pe mujh se
Bhi pehle pisar kaash mera
Shikasta jabeen baandhne ko
Baqee'a se roomaal aaye
english translation text:
May a dawn descend upon my life
that transforms me into Hurr (ع);
May my own son be sacrificed
for Mahdi (عج) before even I am.
And for bandaging my wounded and broken forehead
may a handkerchief come from Baqiya

urdu transliteration:
Uthe shor aamad pe meri
Ke Haider (a) ka hubdaar aaya
Ho elaan larnay ko Mehdi (aj)
Ki jaanib se Mukhtar aaya
Chale tegh ishq-e Ali (a) mein
Hazaaron saron ko udaaye
english translation text:
Let there be cries upon my arrival:
A lover of Haider (ع) has come!
Let the call be made: To represent Mehdi (عج)
Mukhtar has come to fight!
And may the sword, wielded in the love of Ali (ع)
send thousands of heads to the dust.

urdu transliteration:
Dua do humein aaj Zainab (s)
Ke Abbas (a) ki iqtedaa mein
Larein aakhri jang Akbar (a)
Ke humraah hum Karbala mein
Yeh mohlat ki shab hum ko Mehdi (aj)
Ke lashkar se ab ja milaaye
english translation text:
O Zainab (ع) grant us your prayers today,
that in the footsteps of Abbas (ع),
we may fight the final battle of Karbala
alongside Akbar (ع).
May this fleeting night of respite
join us to the army of Mahdi (عج)

urdu transliteration:
Za'eefi mein jo lar raha hai
Sipahi hai woh Murtaza ka
Jhuke ghair ke saamne kya?
Jise khauf hai bas Khuda ka
Ameer-e Najaf ki gali se
Shuja'at ki jo bheek paaye
english translation text:
The one who still fights despite frailty
is a soldier of Murtaza (ع)
How could he bow before anyone
who is only fearful of God?
He who has received alms of courage
from the alleys of the Commander of Najaf.

urdu transliteration:
Dawa uske zakhmon ki leke
Chale aao Waaris-e zameen ke
Sitam se hua laal chehra
Lahoo ke hain cheentay jabeen pe
Teri muntazir kitni sadiyon
Se gham ko hai seene lagaaye
english translation text:
Bring balm for its wounds
and come, O Successor of the Earth;
Oppression has rendered its face red,
and blood adorns its forehead.
For countless centuries, with grief pressed to its chest,
humanity has awaited only You (عج).
